text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Trainer!
Today, I am extra spicy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, it's better than usual, or rather...
I believe the Japanese word is, "hitofumi"...?
choice_data_list: So it has a little extra something special?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeesss! That's right!
Today, I'm cut from a different cloth!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...If I lose like I did the other day,
everyone cheering for me will be sad!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I want to win today's race
and turn it into a happy party for everyone, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No matter who stands in my way... BANG!
I'll blast a hole right through 'em with my running♪
